decision_rule: Support requires a nonzero amplitude with at least three successive complete refinement levels and contracting state, top-transfer and bottom-transfer discrepancies across successive adjacent pairs.
key_findings: D=0 exactly reproduces the existing sharp external-head trajectory.
D=0.02 cm retains full wet fraction f=1 and reproduces the same failure pattern despite lower mean wet head and local surface storage.
D=0.05, 0.10 and 0.25 cm produce wet fractions 0.4, 0.2 and 0.08 respectively and each completes all 20 tested paths through 16 substeps.
Each of D=0.05, 0.10 and 0.25 cm satisfies the preregistered contraction criterion for every tested window.
The mechanism evidence points to partial hydraulic contact / reduced areal contact conductance, not merely lowering the imposed surface head.
